rhopgradient.comment: Initial density gradient 1:Rhop0, 2:Water column, 3:Max. water height (default=2)

hswl.comment: Maximum still water level to calculate speedofsound using coefsound

speedsystem.comment: Maximum system speed (by default the dam-break propagation is used)

speedsound.comment: Speed of sound to use in the simulation (by default speedofsound=coefsound*speedsystem)

coefh.comment: Coefficient to calculate the smoothing length (H=coefficient*sqrt(3*dp^2) in 3D)

gamma.comment: Politropic constant for water used in the state equation

norgeometry.comment: Define initial configuration of normals before applying other configurations

distanceh.comment: Maximum orthogonal distance (H*value) to compute normals data (default=2)

svshapes.comment: Saves VTK with geometry in triangles and quads with its normals for debug (default=false)

point.comment: Point is calculated automatically accoding to normal configuration

maxdisth.comment: Maximum distance to boundary limit. It uses H*maxdisth (default=2)

duration.comment: Movement duration, Zero is the end of simulation (def=0)

phase.comment: Initial wave phase in function of PI (def=0)

savemotion.comment: Saves motion data. xpos and zpos are optional. zpos=-depth of the measuring point

savedata.comment: Saves CSV with data exchange for each time interval (0=all steps)

schemescale.comment: Scale used to create the initial scheme of Chrono objects (default=1)

parameter.comment: Saves particle position using double precision (default=0)
Boundary method 1:DBC, 2:mDBC (default=1)
Slip mode for mDBC 1:DBC vel=0, 2:No-slip, 3:Free Slip (default=1)
Activate No-Penetration option for no-slip or free slip mDBC 0:Off, 1:On (default=0)
Step Algorithm 1:Verlet, 2:Symplectic (def=1)
Verlet only: Number of steps to apply Eulerian equations (def=40)
Interaction Kernel 1:Cubic Spline, 2:Wendland (def=1)
Viscosity Formulation 1:Artificial, 2:Laminar+SPS (def=1)
Viscosity value. Typically 0.01 for Artificial and 1e-6 m^2/s (water kinematic viscosity) for Laminar
Multiply viscosity value with boundary (default=1)
Density Diffusion Term 0:None, 1:Molteni, 2:Fourtakas, 3:Fourtakas(full) (default=0)
DDT value (default=0.1)
Shifting mode 0:None, 1:Ignore bound, 2:Ignore fixed, 3:Full (default=0)
Threshold to detect free surface. Typically 1.5 for 2D and 2.75 for 3D (default=0)
Rigid Algorithm 0:collision-free, 1:SPH, 2:DEM, 3:Chrono (default=1)
Time to freeze the floatings at simulation start (warmup) (default=0)
Coefficient to calculate minimum time step dtmin=coefdtmin*h/speedsound (default=0.05)
Initial time step. Use 0 to default use (default=h/speedsound)
Minimum time step. Use 0 to default use (default=coefdtmin*h/speedsound)
Fixed Dt value. Use 0 to disable (default=disabled)
Dt values are loaded from file. Use NONE to disable (default=disabled)
Time of simulation
Time between output files
Allowed percentage of fluid particles out the domain (def=1)
Minimum rhop valid (def=700)
Maximum rhop valid (def=1300)

simulationdomain.comment: Defines domain of simulation (default=Uses minimum and maximum position of the generated particles)
